Card Q&A.a: No. Digivolution requirements cannot be ignored unless an effect explicitly instructs you to ignore them.
Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [Your Turn] effect digivolve it into any Digimon card regardless of digivolution requirements, so long as it has [X Antibody] in its traits?

Effect: [Your Turn] When one of your effects places a digivolution card under this Digimon, you may digivolve this Digimon into a Digimon card in your hand with [X-Antibody] in its traits by paying its digivolution cost. When this Digimon would digivolve with this effect, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] While this Digimon has [X-Antibody] in its traits, it gains ＜Reboot＞. (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
